documents.title: Red Sea and Bab-el-Mandeb shipping disruption
documents.body: Houthi attacks on commercial shipping in the Red Sea forced carriers to divert around the Cape of Good Hope, cutting Suez Canal transits and lengthening crude voyages to Asia.

documents.title: Sanctions tighten on Russian crude
documents.body: G7 price caps and sanctions on shadow-fleet tankers tightened access to discounted Russian crude, pressuring the Urals flows that India had leaned on.

documents.title: OPEC+ emergency production cut 2026
documents.body: OPEC+ moved to an emergency output cut to defend prices, with Saudi Arabia leading deeper quota reductions. Analysts flagged tighter global balances and upside risk to Brent for import-heavy buyers such as India.
